title: RuleCheckAuthorityRequest
description: The input of rule.check_authority: the company to sweep, as a URI, dsor://org_456/tenant/org_456. The sweep asks the company's KSoR which version of each policy that a rule in force cites is in force, and marks each rule whose policy moved, so its caller names no rule and no version (step 28b's README, decisions D4 and D6). The company must be the call's own, as for proposal.expire_due: the check of the URIs refuses another company's, and DSoR's own check refuses another company's id. This tutorial's own schema: the specification names no operation that checks a control's authority.
